missions.title: Wattle bearers
missions.text: Wild turkeys are appearing on city streets. Help reduce and strengthen their population so that they find a new home here in New Laurentia.
objective_text: Harvest 2 male Wild turkeys. Their Fitness must be the required amount or lower.
Harvest 2 female Wild turkeys. Their Fitness must be the required amount or lower.

missions.title: Cycle of life
missions.text: Snowshoe hares are yet to bounce back to the numbers normal for their population cycle. Harvest healthy individuals to prove the cycle has recovered.
objective_text: Harvest 3 Snowshoe hares. Each animal must weigh the required weight or more.

missions.title: Which one has a white butt?
missions.text: The Mule deer and the White-tail deer. One species has a white tail underside, the other has it white on top. See the difference for yourself.
objective_text: Harvest a Mule deer. Its Trophy rating must be the required stars.
Harvest a White-tailed deer. Its Trophy rating must be the required stars.

missions.title: Hunting solo
missions.text: Prove that hunters can harvest waterfowls without companions in New Laurentia.
objective_text: Harvest 5 Mallards without using your Dog companion. Each bird must weigh the required weight or more.

missions.title: Superhero of the wilderness
missions.text: Wolverines are so elusive that even spotting one is a challenge. Bring a tripod, then harvest one animal.
objective_text: Harvest a Wolverine using a tripod stand.

missions.title: Lure in
missions.text: Find a luring scent suitable for predators and use it when hunting for a Grizzly bear.
objective_text: Harvest a male Grizzly bear using a luring scent.

missions.title: Super pigs
missions.text: Wild boars have become way too dangerous in the areas around New Laurentia. Help gather data so new measures can be taken.
objective_text: Call a Wild boar with its Fitness at the required amount or more. Make sure it reacts and wait until it is the required amount away from you or closer.

missions.title: Quail country
missions.text: Ptarmigan populations are in the healthiest state they've been in years. Help monitor their progress by gathering an average female and male specimen.
objective_text: Harvest a female White-tailed ptarmigan with its Fitness at the required amount or higher.
Harvest a male White-tailed ptarmigan with its Fitness at the required amount or higher.

missions.title: Fifteen stars
missions.text: Now that enough time has passed since the implementation of measures to strengthen the local population following the bovine tuberculosis outbreak, you can harvest elk that have grown into amazing trophies.
objective_text: Harvest 3 Elk with their Trophy ratings at the required stars.

missions.title: Bison bank
missions.text: Help local researchers check up on how the famous New Laurentia bison herds are doing.
objective_text: Harvest a male Bison with its Fitness at the required amount or higher.

missions.title: Iconic pairing
missions.text: A local taxidermist is running a promo campaign for its popular diorama featuring a grizzly bear and a wood bison. Order one and get some money back.
objective_text: Create a taxidermy diorama with a Grizzly bear and a Wood Bison.

missions.title: MooseNews
missions.text: Harvest a moose ethically to educate the hunters who don't use the right ammunition and who make moose suffer more than they should.
objective_text: Harvest a Moose. Shoot it only once using the .338 Lapua Magnum caliber.

missions.title: Weather extremes
missions.text: Dall sheep are having a hard time replicating their numbers. You are encouraged to challenge yourself the next time you want to harvest one and give the sheep a better chance of surviving.
objective_text: Harvest a Dall sheep. Shoot it only once from the required amount or more with the Primacy Vision Unity scope attached.

missions.title: Zip up
missions.text: Ridicule the prankster who put a high-visibility jacket on a mule deer by showing how to properly harvest deer at night.
objective_text: Harvest a Mule deer. Shoot it between the required amount-the required amount, with a night vision scope attached.

missions.title: Artificial route
missions.text: Challenge yourself and experience how habitat encroachment forces Pronghorns to adapt their migratory routes.
objective_text: Harvest a Pronghorn. Its Fitness must be the required amount or higher. Shoot it only once to the heart from the required amount or more.

missions.title: Angel on your shoulder
missions.text: You've been tasked with getting to know the locals and helping them with their current issues, such as habitat enhancement and promotion. You'll also need to recruit one new Hearth & Hunt member in order to be officially recognized for your work.
objective_text: Check out the Hearth & Hunt files on the locals.

missions.title: For the hearth
missions.text: Hearth & Hunt, the new company you've been hired by, has a special tradition! You have to harvest a mule deer to create a taxidermy piece. It isn't the worst tradition for a hunting company!
objective_text: Harvest a male Mule deer near your Lodge. Choose to taxidermy it when harvesting.

missions.title: For the hunt
missions.text: Just like Hearth & Hunt is made up of two connected families, the tradition of hunting the mule deer is made up of two parts as well. The second part is to create a taxidermy piece in your Lodge!
objective_text: Place a male Mule deer in a diorama with a mid-sized herbivore in your lodge.
Take a look at your surroundings at a Map board in the Lodge.

missions.title: Heterochromia Iridum
missions.text: Juniper, a dog trainer Hearth & Hunt is hoping to recruit, isn't very open to the idea. She likes her solitude and prefers to partner with silent companions. She's giving you an opportunity to show her your hunting dog's skills, this could be an opportunity to strike up a conversation.
objective_text: Have your Dog companion successfully find and follow the blood trail of any shot White-tailed deer.
Harvest a male White-tailed deer with your Dog companion active at the time of the shot.

missions.title: Who let the bloodhounds out?
missions.text: Juniper is getting ready for a national competition for blood-tracking dogs, so she's prepared an artificial blood track to train her dog, Bug. But she thinks it's too easy for her dog, and also encourages you to train on a real hunt. She shares her secret technique and tells you it's easier to train dogs at night.
objective_text: Shoot and harvest an Elk between the required amount-the required amount with your Dog companion active at the time of the shot.

missions.title: Friendly competition
missions.text: Juniper challenged you to harvest more Wolverines than her. She said she'd join Hearth & Hunt if you manage to beat her. It's just a friendly competition with the best dog trainer around... No pressure!
objective_text: Shoot and harvest 3 Wolverines.

missions.title: Parasomnias
missions.text: Bug is lost! Or... maybe she's not, and Juniper is just panicking. A lone Dall sheep was reportedly inexpertly shot by a hunter, but he couldn't find the carcass. According to Juniper, that's probably not true, and the hunter likely missed entirely. Now it's up to you to track and harvest the sheep, as it keeps returning to areas with little food and water.
objective_text: Locate and harvest the lone Dall sheep.

missions.title: Crystal clarity
missions.text: Patrick Harper has been a member of Hearth & Hunt for a long time, and he's a huge fan. He wants to participate in a competition for members, but he doesn't have time with all the promotions he's planning for New Laurentia. He's relying on you to take on the assignment on scopes.
objective_text: Harvest an animal using a bow sight.
Harvest an animal using a crossbow sight.
Harvest an animal with a bolt-action rifle without using a scope.

missions.title: Talk turkey to me
missions.text: Patrick is still knee-deep in creating videos for New Laurentia. It sounds like he's having problems with Regina, but doesn't want to talk about it. For this video, he wants to make Wild turkeys the main stars, he just needs you to get them closer.
objective_text: Call 3 Wild turkeys to a distance of the required amount or less from you.

missions.title: Competition espionage
missions.text: The new assignment from the Hearth & Hunt forum. Patrick is supposed to check out some gear from the competition, WildHeart, but he doesn't have time, as usual. Too many social media websites for him to monitor!
objective_text: Harvest a Wood bison using the WildHeart Front Cover blind.
Harvest a Northwestern gray wolf using the Primos Trigger Stick Gen3 Tall Monopod shooting stick.

missions.title: Pieris marginalis
missions.text: Habitat enhancement is an important part of hunting—it's all about caring for the well-being of animals and the nature that surrounds them. Regina Harper is in charge of habitat enhancement in New Laurentia. She wants you to broaden your horizons and learn more by creating a butterfly garden and removing invasive plant species.
objective_text: Find invasive plant species in the location highlighted on your Map and remove them.
Create a butterfly garden.

missions.title: Cercyonis pegala
objective_text: Wait for a day and try to talk to Regina again.
Try to talk to Regina again.
Harvest 3 White-tailed deer with their Fitness at the required amount or lower.

missions.title: Erynnis lucilius
missions.text: Regina has had samples from sick Moose in the area analyzed, and the results are in—it's brainworm. A parasite that doesn't affect White-tailed deer at all, but once moose get infected, the brainworm happy-tunnels through their brain, leading to an agonizing death. Regina's got a location of more sick moose in the area, and wants you to help cull them.
objective_text: Harvest the sick moose in the highlighted area on the hunting map.

missions.title: Speiredonia mutabilis
missions.text: The tragic tale of the Moose continues. Regina's had another dream, this time even more horrific than the one before. In this dream, the Moose attacks her husband and ends up with antlers covered in his blood. Coincidentally, a Moose with bloodied antlers appears in the area. Patrick claims it's just shedding velvet, but Regina fears something even worse is about to happen.
objective_text: Get to the area of the last known sighting of the moose with bloodied antlers.

missions.title: Tyria Jacobaeae
missions.text: Regina is trying to help a moose she dreamt of, its antlers bloodied. But is it real?
objective_text: Enter the swamps and get ready for the moose with bloodied antlers.
Option 1: Shoot and harvest the Moose with bloodied antlers.
Option 2: Leave the highlighted zone and let the Moose live.
Look for Patrick in his usual spot.
Talk to Regina.
Talk to Patrick.

missions.title: Fox fires
missions.text: Mikael highlighted the Spots on the Hunting map that Dall sheep frequent. Go there to learn more about animal daily routines. Mikael encourages you to open the interactive map and click on animal icons to reveal more information about the Spots. Find one and analyze the Tracks there.
objective_text: Analyze any Dall sheep feeding or resting zones. The areas where to find them are highlighted on the Hunting map.
Harvest a Dall sheep.

missions.title: Loudest deer
missions.text: Mikael has been taking care of an elk herd for years. He wants you to take a look at a high-fitness elk for yourself.
objective_text: Harvest a male Rocky Mountain elk. Its Fitness must be the required amount or higher.

missions.title: Pack dynamics
missions.text: Animals possess intelligence that often surprises people. The older and fitter an animal is, the better it conceals itself. That's when calling becomes essential!
objective_text: Buy a Primos Double Jackrabbit Predator Call.
Harvest a Northwestern gray wolf.
Call a Northwestern gray wolf to the distance of the required amount or less from you.

missions.title: One shot, no waste
missions.text: For larger animals, you need more effective firearms so you don’t lose as much meat due to damage caused by the ammunition. So this is the perfect time to save up some money and buy a better rifle!
objective_text: Harvest a Wood bison shot to its vitals (the heart or lungs).

missions.title: A hunt for a home
missions.text: Your travels in New Laurentia have come to an end. All that's left to do is update the data on the locals with the new information you've learned, and it will be shared with the rest of the Hearth & Hunt company.
objective_text: Update the Hearth & Hunt binder.

missions.title: To recurve or not to recurve?
missions.text: Someone who's trying to look impartial is asking themselves a question: which is better, a compound crossbow or a recurve? They make a list of the various pros and cons, and in the end they settle on the recurve crossbow. What about you?
objective_text: Harvest a male Blesbok using a recurve crossbow. Shoot only once, delivering between the required amount and the required amount of energy.

missions.title: Right time, right place
missions.text: To help develop your hunting skills, and encourage you to think on your feet, you've undertaken a task set by a world-renowned gun trainer. If you want to get the harvest even when the circumstances aren't ideal, you make them ideal, or you don't take the shot.
objective_text: Harvest a Blue wildebeest. Shoot it only once from a rifle.
Harvest a Yellow-billed duck. Shoot it only once from a bow.

missions.title: The golden hour
missions.text: This writer needs a picture for his book. He doesn't want you to take the photograph—he wants to take it. Your job is to bring a male and a female lion together during the golden hour. And he has more feline trivia: a lion's roar can be heard from up to 5 miles (8 kilometers) away.
objective_text: Shoot and harvest a male Lion during the golden hour, from (the required amount until the required amount).
Shoot and harvest a female Lion during the golden hour, from (the required amount until the required amount).

missions.title: A perfectly sensible gift
missions.text: Professor Wax wants to give his wife a thoughtful gift to make up for her losing her favorite earrings. He's planning to give her... giant kudu horns that look just like her lost earrings. Maybe she'll like them! It's your job to find the best kudu for his gift.
objective_text: Harvest a Greater kudu. Its Trophy rating must be the required stars.

missions.title: Crocodylidpoxvirus
missions.text: A local veterinary epidemiologist is warning about an illness that spreads quickly among young crocodiles. She's asking for your assistance to help prevent it.
objective_text: Harvest a young Crocodile with its Fitness at the required amount or lower.

missions.title: Who runs the world?
missions.text: A local ethologist is observing the societal behavior of spotted hyenas and wants your help to determine how dominance patterns shift after losing the alpha female.
objective_text: Harvest 3 female Spotted hyenas. Their Trophy ratings must be the required stars or higher.

missions.title: Dangerous evolution
missions.text: Someone is deeply concerned about the way that ostriches evolved. They want to have an ostrich for themselves as a constant reminder of how our own future might turn out.
objective_text: Harvest an Ostrich shot from the required amount or closer. The animal must not be alerted before the shot. Don't use any blinds or stands.

missions.title: Cape buffalo is the new beef
missions.text: This person is quite well-known among hunters for always trying to get her hands on new types of meat! You've heard rumors it's because of a bet she made with her grandfather, which seems to be the case. This time, it's cape buffalo meat.
objective_text: Harvest a mature male Cape buffalo.
Harvest a mature female Cape buffalo.

missions.title: Nighttime facts
missions.text: A wildlife researcher is having a beef with his friend. She doesn’t believe certain species hunt at night. Numerous books with research don’t matter to her, so he asks you to hunt at night so he can confront her with hard facts.
objective_text: Shoot and harvest a Warthog from the required amount until the required amount. Use a night vision scope.
Shoot and harvest a Lion from the required amount until the required amount. Use a night vision scope.
Shoot and harvest a Honey badger from the required amount until the required amount. Use a night vision scope.

missions.title: Crying wolf
missions.text: A local pub quiz enthusiast is collecting random animal trivia on his quest to best his rival. But he also wants to go beyond just learning the facts, he needs to see them in nature. The newest trivia piece requires observing impalas from a greater distance.
objective_text: Harvest an Impala shot from the required amount or more. Don't use a scope when shooting.

missions.title: Record-breaking training
missions.text: Records are meant to be broken! But maybe not just yet... How about you start with some training first? Grab a bow with arrows and aim for the crocodile.
objective_text: Harvest a Crocodile shot with a bow.

missions.title: Pigs International
missions.text: Very officially sounding International Pig Committee (all its rules are completely transparent!) has announced that warthog is the third-cutest animal in the Suidae (pig) family! They just need more specimens of warthogs with low-scoring trophies.
objective_text: Harvest a Warthog. Its Trophy rating must be the required stars.

missions.title: A painful task
missions.text: There are some disagreements that need to be resolved and some that don’t need to be. Let’s solve this and prove what the real zebra color is once and for all.
objective_text: Harvest a young Mountain zebra. Its Fitness must be between the required amount and the required amount.

missions.title: Pause for hippos
missions.text: Malachi wants to popularize hunting hippos, so you should lead by example! And let’s not put him to shame and aim for big ones, shall we?
objective_text: Harvest 3 Hippos. Each animal must weigh the required weight or more.

missions.title: Kilimaya hunting extravaganza
missions.text: Sidney, Malachi's business partner, likes to give people work. And since he feels like he is not hunting much on his own, this will at least give him the feeling of belonging to the community. The challenge is a bit specific, but that’s how he likes it.
objective_text: Harvest a Northern black korhaan between the required amount-the required amount. Shoot it with a rifle from the required amount or more.

missions.title: Pandora's box
missions.text: Meeting a new Hearth & Hunt coordinator is always intense. This time, it's the energetic Pandora, who's nothing like her brother Angel from New Laurentia. Your first job here is to get acquainted with the locals of Kilimaya Reserve.
objective_text: Check out the Hearth & Hunt files on the locals.

missions.title: Marketing matters
missions.text: You've met Malachi, allegedly a famous person back from Tikamoon Plains. He doesn't seem to be very good with technology. Patrick Harper from New Laurentia has been trying to encourage him to update the promotional video for Kilimaya Reserve, but now you're in charge.
objective_text: Place the camera to film a promotional video for Malachi.
Harvest a Blesbok. Fatally shoot it at a distance of the required amount or less from the camera.

missions.title: Balloons, ducks, and snakes
objective_text: Harvest 5 Yellow-billed ducks. Their Fitness must be the required amount or lower.
Investigate the unusual occurrences at the locations sent by Malachi.
Look for more clues that will reveal information about the stalker around the marked areas.

missions.title: Savannah stalker
objective_text: Harvest 3 female Greater kudus.

missions.title: Chalk and talk
missions.text: The erratic Damian, who doesn't look like the best possible choice for a teaching position, needs to prepare a curriculum for a course covering advanced bow-shooting techniques. Since the students are advanced, the assignments he comes up with are pretty challenging, but he needs to make sure that they're doable. And that's where you come in.
objective_text: Harvest a male Mountain zebra using Skye Ferran Wonder bow.

missions.title: Teacher's pet
objective_text: Call Pandora to talk about Damian's idea.
Speak to Damian and put Pandora on speakerphone.
Harvest 3 Ostriches using Terra Fractal TR bow.

missions.title: Empirical learning
objective_text: Enter the area near Hippopotamus territories.
Harvest a Hippo. Shoot it to the heart or lungs from the required amount or closer. Use a single arrow.
Talk to Damian.

missions.title: Knives out
objective_text: Talk to Pandora about how to proceed.
Wait for a day and then talk to Naomi again.
Talk to Naomi again.
Harvest a male Cape buffalo shot with only one arrow.

missions.title: Crocodile tears
missions.text: Are you dreaming? Naomi seems to now trust you enough to ask for help. Let's grab the bull by the horns! She needs help with an extremely vicious Crocodile that has already claimed several victims. How can you identify it? It's carrying a Crocs shoe in its mouth.
objective_text: Find the vicious Crocodile and harvest it.

missions.title: Final roar
missions.text: Naomi shares a story about her "spirit animal", a half-blind Lion she was supposed to cull. But she can't bring herself to do it, as it reminds her too much of herself and her recent hunting accident.
objective_text: Find the half-blind Lion and harvest it.
Talk to Naomi.

missions.title: The last gift
missions.text: You did it! You managed to help everyone at Kilimaya Reserve. Pandora has one last task for you, which is mostly a celebratory tradition—to update the Hearth & Hunt binder with all the info you've gathered on the locals.
objective_text: Update the Hearth & Hunt binder.
